'''Waskiro''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The planet was heavily involved in trade, namely [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|At some point in history]], the contact with the mining [[Colonies/Legends|colony]] was lost.<ref name="Explorer's Legacy">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Fate of Waskiro}}</ref>
